Retrieve a list of data export connectors. Each data export connector defines the Data Exports it runs and the credentials it uses.

info.name: Run a data export connector job

params.name: connectorId
params.description: The unique identifier of the data export connector to run a job for.

items.docs:
Dispatch a job for the specified data export connector. The job runs the connector's exports using the production version. The response returns an `id` that you can use to monitor the job's progress with `GET /v1alpha/data/export-connectors/jobs/{jobId}`.

info.name: Create a data export connector credential

items.docs:

info.name: Validate a data export connector credential

items.docs:
Validate that a data export connector credential can connect to its destination. Validation runs asynchronously. The response returns an `id` that you can use to poll for the validation result with `GET /v1alpha/data/export-connectors/credentials/validations/{id}`. Specify an `id` to validate an existing credential or `parameters` to validate a new set of credential values without persisting the credentials.

info.name: Retrieve a data export connector credential's validation result

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the credential validation request.

items.docs:
Retrieve the validation results for a credential. Use the `id` returned by `POST /v1alpha/data/export-connectors/credentials/validations`. Validation runs asynchronously. Poll this endpoint until the result is available. * While validation is still in progress, the response is `200 OK` with a `null` body. Continue polling. * After validation completes, the response is `200 OK` with a body indicating whether the validation succeeded and listing any errors.

info.name: Update a data export connector credential

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the data export connector credential to update.

items.docs:

info.name: Retrieve a data export connector job's status

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the data export connector job.

items.docs:
Retrieve the status of a data export connector job. Use the `id` returned by `POST /v1alpha/data/export-connectors/connectors/{connectorId}/jobs`. The response returns the job's status, any error message, and the statuses of its spawned sync jobs. A sync job sends the data from Visier to the target system, such as Databricks or Snowflake.
